name: Huskfield Meadow
description: Seed weevils share ribbed pods and grain stores with wind tufts and ScrambleSnail. Tall stalks shelter a worn dirt harvest lane; loose husks and seed fluff gather at the field edges.
motifs: Ribbed husks, grain heads, windseed fluff and a small granary.

name: Dewcap Grove
description: DewBud and NectarBloom favor the wet edge, while Sporeling, SporeKeeper and MossMole occupy the shaded logs. Skimray connects the plant theme to the pools. A leaf-litter path threads between mushroom groves.
motifs: Dew leaves, nectar blooms, spotted caps, mossy logs and shallow pools.

name: Shellstone Tide
description: SkitterCrab, Conelet and Horseshoe inhabit the shell banks; SiltSkorp and Platefin suit the silt pools. SpireSquid gives the old spiral fossils an elder connection. Textured shell sand separates the exposed fossil beds from the water.
motifs: Spiral fossils, armored shells, tidal pools, layered reef stone and a short jetty.

name: Cinderflint Quarry
description: CoalGrub, CinderCocoon and FurnaceBeetle form the hot-soil family. Ember and WaggleWorm fit the vents, while Flintling and GeodeGuard inhabit the cooler mineral face. Packed grit lanes connect the coal working to the crystal pocket.
motifs: Coal, clinker, vents, faceted geodes and abandoned mine timbers.
